content:
From Deep Visibility results, add a SHA1 hash to the Blacklist. Set the scope of the Blacklist: Global, Account, Site, or Group. The SHA1 and the Agent ID are required (see
Deep Visibility > Get Events). Your role must have permissions to change the Blacklist - Admin, IR Team, SOC - and your user scope access must include the scope of the
Agent. The target scope is the Group, Site, or Account of the Agent.
Deep Visibility requires Complete SKU.
